title: DSSSB Various Post Answer Key
vacancyDetails: Answer key related update for Various Post Codes – Answer Key
selectionProcess: Written / CBT → Answer Key / Objections → Result
documentsRequired: Registration number / roll number; admit card for reference
howToApply:
1. Visit https://dsssb.delhi.gov.in
2. Open Answer Key / Response Sheet section
3. Download DSSSB Various Post Answer Key
4. Match answers with your response sheet
5. Raise objections within the official window if allowed
shortDescription: DSSSB Various Post Answer Key available. Check post-wise keys at dsssb.delhi.gov.in.
content:
Delhi Subordinate Services Selection Board (DSSSB) has released answer keys for various post codes.

Candidates should open the Results / Answer Key section on dsssb.delhi.gov.in, select their exam date / post code and download the official key or response sheet.
